name: Selfie Stick of Unwanted Reach
flavor_text: A telescoping wand for forcing your personal brand into everyone else's weather.
rules_text: On hit, deal cringe damage. If the target is already Distracted, push them 5 ft and apply Uncomfortable until the start of your next turn.

name: Rolling Suitcase of Momentum
flavor_text: The hard-shell choir of airport tiles sings your battle hymn.
rules_text: On hit, deal sonic damage. If used while moving at least one zone this turn, also force a DEX save DC 12 or knock the target Prone.

name: Mechanical Keyboard of Clacking
flavor_text: Every keystroke sounds like a tiny lawsuit.
rules_text: On hit, deal sonic damage. Creatures in the same zone have disadvantage on Concentration checks until the start of your next turn.
